answer.description:
Buying your first home can be exciting, confusing, and everything in between -- and you don’t have to go through it alone. 

This community aims to provide a place where members can ask questions, share stories, and celebrate wins! 

We welcome everyone from window shoppers and house hunters to experienced buyers, hobbyists, and pros. 

Please review the rules, and use user flair and post flair to keep conversations helpful and on track.
